about: Would You Rather? silly choices: a warm-up, no points. The teacher spins to pick a team; the team says its choice and why. M.1 simple words, M.2 a little longer, M.3 imaginative. Each choice is short so it fits the phone. Written for Kru. At least 50 per level, shuffled every game.

intro.title: Who answers?
text: The teacher spins to pick a team.
That team says its choice and why.

intro.title: Give a reason
text: The funnier the reason, the better!

example.big: I'd rather have ears like a rabbit because I could hear everything.
